Nantong Jianghai.why: Capacitor maker (aluminum electrolytic incl. MLPC / solid-liquid hybrid, film, supercapacitors EDLC / LIC) whose server-power and data-center sales are a stated growth driver; more AI data-center power build-out lifts its capacitor demand.
Nantong Jianghai.evidence: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026): built new fully automatic snap-in aluminum electrolytic lines suited to data centers; supercapacitor demand in data centers and grid frequency regulation is good and deliveries have reached scale.

players.product: aluminum electrolytic capacitors (incl. MLPC and solid-liquid hybrid), film capacitors and supercapacitors (EDLC / LIC) for server and data-center power

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, results briefing): 2026 got off to a good start - demand is strong and orders plentiful in every business segment and capacity utilisation is at a high level; the aim is for server power supplies to become a substantive new growth engine. 2026 priorities: improve MLPC reliability to achieve a volume breakthrough at the server-power end; fully roll out snap-in aluminum electrolytic capacitors in global server-power applications and strive for a larger share; scale up film-capacitor sales in SST and three-phase AC applications and gradually win a fitting share at the aluminum-electrolytic strategic customers. Management says its aluminum electrolytic capacitors are at the industry forefront in data-center applications.

Management (IR record): supercapacitors are already benefiting deeply from server UPS and data-center power-supply upgrades - both EDLC and LIC products have gone through trials, certification and batch trial runs with global power-supply customers; in 2026 it has already achieved revenue at the tens-of-millions-of-RMB level, and the company is striving for annual revenue above RMB 1.5 hundred million. It has begun line automation and capacity expansion and is working on customer technical support, key-material supply and cost reduction.
quarterly_data.figure: target: annual revenue above RMB 1.5 hundred million (2026 so far at the tens-of-millions-of-RMB level)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): over the past year bulk raw-material prices kept rising - the core material aluminum rose nearly 20% - while fierce competition in consumer electronics and industrial control and customers' demands for better quality at lower prices squeezed profit. 2026 measures: shift the product mix toward high-growth areas such as AI and photovoltaics and shrink low-margin traditional consumer products; automate and upgrade old and semi-automatic lines; replace imported raw materials with domestic ones; cut costs through product and technology development.
